title: Convert mask to paint / paint to mask, from the canvas context menu
description:
Image-mode canvas context menu gains two conversions next to the existing Clear mask / Send to Composite: 'Convert mask to paint' (enabled when the canvas has a mask) and 'Convert paint to mask' (enabled when the paint layer has content). Both gates already exist on the viewer - el.hasMask() and el.hasPaint() - so enablement needs no new plumbing; the conversion itself belongs on MaskManager/PaintManager and is exposed through MpiCanvasViewer like clearMask/clearPaint, never reached into from the Block.

Both directions mutate a STORED layer (manualCanvas for mask, paintCanvas for paint), so both are layer-wide one-shot ops that MUST call _recordUndo() before mutating and AFTER the no-op guard, or they are silent holes in Ctrl+Z.

Follow-up on the MPI-424 canvas tool family (that umbrella closed with MPI-373; this does not re-open it). Three product questions carry assumed defaults in brief.md - paint colour source, whether the source layer survives, alpha vs luminance - confirm before building.
acceptance: Right-click on the image canvas shows Convert mask to paint and Convert paint to mask alongside the existing Clear mask / Send to Composite, which are unchanged
Each item is disabled with an info reason when its source layer is empty, gated on viewer.el.hasMask() / viewer.el.hasPaint()
Conversion logic lives on MaskManager / PaintManager and is exposed through MpiCanvasViewer el.*; the Block never touches a canvas directly
Both directions record undo with _recordUndo() before mutating and after the no-op guard - Ctrl+Z restores the destination layer pixel-for-pixel, and an empty-source conversion pushes NO entry
paint -> mask writes manualCanvas, not the derived maskCanvas (docs/masking-undo.md: only manual + subtract are stored)
The three open questions in brief.md are answered by the user and recorded there before code starts
Verified by pixel probe, not a DOM click; node --test "tests/*.test.cjs" green; the fact is written to docs/painting.md or docs/masking.md (no catch-all)
